items.message: Issue title/body flows into PR title and body without sanitisation at the boundary visible in this diff
Compiled-but-never-executed code path: `compile()` check does not prevent execution of attacker-influenced text that passes syntax validation
ISSUE number interpolated into artifact name without validation — low-severity but worth noting

Diff truncation notice: `fix/from-issue` and `fix/propose` workflow implementations are in the scaffold string constant, not in separately reviewed Python modules. The `ChangeGuard` behaviour referenced in comments on the propose workflow is not visible in this diff. If `Scm.open_change` does not enforce branch-prefix constraints independently of the changeset content, the trust boundary described in the scaffold comment would not hold. I cannot confirm or deny this from what was provided.
